items.title: 📈 Earnings Snippet: GameStop
items.summary: GameStop on Tuesday posted a second-quarter profit of $298.7 million, compared with $168.6 million a year earlier. The videogame retailer’s net income came within the forecast range it had given last month.

items.title: GameStop Profit Rises, Boosts Full Year Outlook
items.summary: GameStop  reported higher profit in its latest quarter, boosted by an increase in collectibles sales, and raised its full-year outlook.  The videogame retailer on Tuesday posted a second-quarter profit of $298.7 million, or 51 cents a share, compared with $168.6 million, or 31 cents a share, a year earlier.  Adjusted earnings per share were 27 cents.
